title: Dashboards
summary: Dashboards support monitoring and decisions by prioritizing questions and actions.

MUST.text: Define audience, decisions and review cadence before selecting KPIs.

SHOULD.text: Show metric definition, time period, comparison baseline and freshness.

AVOID.text: Do not fill dashboards with vanity metrics or decorative charts.

DECIDE.decision: Show setup path or labeled demo data
Show freshness timestamp and refresh action

EXAMPLE.good: Overdue invoices card shows count, aging buckets and a Review action
EXAMPLE.bad: Total users tile with no definition, period or next action

FAILURE_MODES: Vanity metrics displace decisions; validate each KPI against a user question.
Stale data presented as current misleads; always show freshness.
Dense charts without actions leave users stuck; provide next step.
